nodes.odebrane.text.t: The gravedigger eats half the loaf standing up, elbow propped on his spade. "Good bread. Tell the baker there's no room in the graveyard for her temper, but I could find a spot for the woman herself. Not soon, mind."

nodes.s.options.[daj].text.t: I'm handing over the bread from the baker.

nodes.s.text.t: The gravedigger is digging. He stops to look at you hopefully, and goes back to digging when he sees your hands are empty.
